title: Sunday Quick Tip
subtitle: Your best hitter
hook: One player drives in most of your team's runs.
intro: Everyone waits for them to come up.
The rest of the lineup stops expecting to hit.
statement: A star player can lift a team or flatten it.
q1: Do you remind the team that every at-bat matters —
q2: or let your best hitter carry the offense?
q3: What do the other players need to grow?
t1: Every team is different. But teams grow
t2: when the best player helps others shine.
cta: Coaches — how do you handle a star hitter?
ctaLines: Move the runner. Every at-bat counts. Let them hit.
Spread it out or ride the hot bat?
ctaPrompt: Share your habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
One player drives in most of your team's runs.
Everyone waits for them to come up. The rest of the lineup stops expecting to hit.
A star player can lift a team or flatten it.
Spread the load or ride the hot bat. Both can work.
How do you handle a star hitter? Share your habit in the comments.
